The companion Joukan guide (route_joukan.json) spends its own Continue on the 瑠璃亜編 branch and separately walks through Joukan's own End17「灯子編」as a badEndPath detour there, but per this task's scope that Joukan-side content is out of scope here — this guide covers only the Gekan-side 灯子編 branch, reached independently via the Ooka Report. xneo.jp's Gekan page documents the Ooka Report mechanic only in service of reaching 瑠璃亜編 (its own Ending 20 and Ending 27 rows both open with an explicit ＜大岡レポート＞ choice sequence); it does not document any path to 灯子編 through the Ooka Report, so jpGuide1 is empty for this step group specifically.

simpleJp: 父さん、何処へ行くの？
enGuide: This exact choice text appears in both xneo.jp's Ending 6 row (as its 2nd item) and its Ending 9/10/24 rows (as their shared item just before ぼくはなにを……), confirming it is a single common checkpoint before this route's endings diverge further. Note (post-#12 correction): this route previously also included a "父さん、ここは？" choice and a following こんなところに…… B.S.S. trigger immediately after this step, on the theory that they were a shared backbone segment with route_yami_no_ou.json/route_kyuumei.json. That is a clean, mutually exclusive split indicating those two lines are 闇の王編-specific alternates, not a step in 灯子編's own path. Both steps have been removed from this route as likely-misattributed content; see research.json's disagreements field for the related この土地……？/いらないよ uncertainty this route already flags at an earlier point.
